metadata.name: Primeval Park
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A dinosaur park on a jungle island on a stormy night. The visitor centre's rotunda holds a great skeleton between the gift shop and the restaurant, with the control room upstairs. A tour road loops north past the paddocks: the Rex behind its huge fence and goat post, the raptors in their high concrete pen, the spitters and the aviary, across a jungle river with a boat ride, to the helipad on the rise. The control room can cut the fence power for 20 seconds and open every gate. Co-op: radio for the chopper, survive three waves and the Rex's breakout, then get everyone to the helipad. Team modes: the visitor centre against the helipad, with the residents loose as a hazard. The dinosaurs are played by the creature kit: a giant scolitex, puglins and imps, cyclopes and oculi.

entities.name: Wave 1: raptors from the west jungle

objectives.text: Radio for the evac chopper from the control room
Hold out until the chopper arrives

do.text: The storm has cut Primeval Park off. Radio for the evac chopper from the control room upstairs. The fence power switch is there too: 20 seconds with every paddock gate open.
Fence power down! The paddock gates are open!
Fence power restored. Whatever got out is still out.
Chopper is three and a half minutes out. Something heard that radio. Raptors in the west jungle!
Spitters coming up from the east paddocks!
The Rex has broken through its gate! Everything in the north jungle is coming!
The chopper is on the pad! Everyone to the helipad in the north-east!
Nobody is leaving the island tonight.
